pages.text: $(l)Pride Suppression$()$(br)Cuts attack speed and attack damage by 50%. Vanity's Edge applies it to nearby allies, pets, and companions while held.
$(l)Losing Pride$()$(br)Movement speed, attack speed, and attack damage are all cut by 80%.
$(l)Bravery$()$(br)The rare opposite of Losing Pride. Much higher attack speed and attack damage, plus Regeneration.
$(l)Coveted Target$()$(br)The enemy Covetfang has claimed. Easier to chase down, and gives better rewards when killed.
$(l)Envy Score$()$(br)How Covetfang compares a target to you: health, max health, armor, movement speed, and beneficial effects.
